# Find a county

Search by county name to see reported Governor votes, candidate percentages, and the county’s reporting time.

<section class="panel county-explorer-panel">
  <label for="county-search"><strong>Search California counties</strong></label>
  <input
    class="county-search"
    id="county-search"
    type="search"
    list="county-options"
    autocomplete="off"
    placeholder="Start typing a county name"
    aria-describedby="county-search-status"
  >
  <datalist id="county-options"></datalist>
  <p class="county-search-status" id="county-search-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
  <div id="county-results"></div>
  <a class="btn btn-outline-primary hero-button" href="index.html">Return to statewide view</a>
</section>

```{r}
#| label: county-explorer-data
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)

county_data <- read_csv(
  "data/clean/ca_2026_county_results.csv",
  col_types = cols(reporting_timestamp = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  select(county, FIPS, candidate, party, votes, vote_percentage, reporting_timestamp)

county_json <- toJSON(
  county_data,
  dataframe = "rows",
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  na = "null"
)
cat(
  "<script id='county-results-data' type='application/json'>",
  as.character(county_json),
  "</script>",
  sep = "\n"
)
```

<script src="county-explorer.js" defer></script>

<p class="source-note">Source: California Secretary of State county Governor results API. County-level reporting timestamps are shown in Pacific time; results are unofficial.</p>
